qualification: every development fold and all three seeds: recall >=0.95, normal FPR <0.10; selected policy must also pass each of three second-partition folds at seed4220; these are internal reused-data checks, not independent factory confirmation
selection: eligible only if all nine development FPRs <0.10; maximize worst recall, then worst small-defect recall, then mean recall, then minimize mean FPR, then prefer fewer extra epochs, no tiles, no small weighting, method name, alpha; if no FPR-eligible policy, minimize worst FPR first
official_test_policy: never decode, score, calibrate, inspect, or select on official test
